title: Regular weekly engagement at the Pleasure Club hall
summary: Two seasons of Tuesdays at a club on 8th Street, packed halls, sometimes two bands.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands

It was in the hall. Just across the river then. Just across the river. Just across the river. Remember any of the other main jobs you had?
